package.description: A lightweight cron-like job scheduler for Windows and beyond.

en-US.description: A lightweight cron-like job scheduler for Windows and beyond.
en-US.longDescription:
cron schedules shell commands with the classic 5-field cron syntax and runs a
tiny foreground scheduler that fires them as they come due. Single binary, no
background service, no database - just a small JSON crontab.
en-US.name: cron
